snippet.title: Music Girl Hatsune Miku iOS App - Official Teaser
snippet.description:
"Music Girl Hatsune Miku" is a music player app.
Miku dances to the tunes installed in your music player and communicates with you!

App Store:
日本語版: https://itunes.apple.com/jp/app/music-girl-chu-yinmiku/id512849356?mt=8
English Version:  Available in August 1, 2013
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/music-girl-hatsune-miku-e/id652722751?l=ja&ls=1&mt=8

App Features:
- Select a song from iPhone/iPod touch, and listen to the music together with Miku, and If the BPM is acquired then Miku can move to the beat of the song and show various types of movements.
- The users can enjoy communication with Miku while listening to music, and if the closeness level rises then the user can receive special presents. 
- Users can enjoy changing Miku's fashion by acquiring new hairstyles, accessories and wardrobes available at the store inside the app.  More items will be added and available in the future.

公式サイト:http://mg-miku.com/

*Music Girl Hatsune Miku iOS app is a joint project between Crypton Future Media, SEGA, MARZA ANIMATION PLANET (which created many of the 3D CG for SEGA's games, including Project DIVA) and iOS development firm W Rock Games.

Copyrights: (C) SEGA / (C) Crypton Future Media, INC.
